title: Shared invertible action basis with sparse private skill residuals
hypothesis: A rank-2 shared orthogonal action basis plus small shared skill Views can represent common skills, while sparse private residual codes restore one deliberately heterogeneous skill at lower complete bytes than independent per-skill policies, without losing heldout OOD action accuracy.
physical_object: one shared 8D orthogonal action transform and rank-2 residual basis
mirror_coordinate: per-skill 2D orthogonal View coefficients plus an optional private residual selector/value
logical_multiplicity: four invertible action maps, including one exceptional skill

world.ood_shift: heldout inputs have an orthogonal 2-plane shift absent from all fitting examples
world.teacher: known orthogonal matrices generated from shared rank-2 Givens orbit; skill 3 includes a fixed rank-1 off-orbit private perturbation

fresh.release_rule: Do not open fresh data if the development payload misses the 25% savings gate or native low-rank/Givens controls match exactly.

controls: independent full policy matrix per skill
shared rank-2 native low-rank coefficient table
shared Givens views plus sparse private rank-1 residual
per-skill dense private residual upper control
metrics: actual complete NPZ inference payload bytes

storage.authority: actual compressed NPZ inference payload bytes

success_gate: OOD nRMSE <=0.02 and success >=0.95 for all skills, >=25% fewer full bytes than independent policies, and strict quality-per-byte improvement over native shared low-rank/Givens and private rank-1 controls.
failure_gate: FAIL if private residual cannot recover the exceptional skill, full bytes save <25%, or standard low-rank/Givens controls equal the View at no greater bytes/compute.

compute.operation_count: dense 8x8 transform 64 MAC; each rank-1 residual adds 16 MAC; Givens view adds 16 scalar arithmetic ops

boundaries: Synthetic linear policy maps only; no robot, manipulation, simulator, or safety claim.
OOD shift is a fixed heldout orthogonal input-plane transform shared by all methods and is not inferred.
No fresh/audit seeds will be opened after native alias or frozen storage gate failure.
